description: Export the users of an app with everything the app holds about them (personal data of its users, for the owner of the app only): the full record (saved data, public info, communications, stats, language, the email if it was shared) and their purchase balances. For a developer taking their app data with them. Paginated by cursor: pass the `next` you got back as `after` until it is null. The cross-app Neblla account id is not included — only the per-app `_id`.

after.description: The `next` cursor from the previous page

env.description: Whose data: "pro" (the users', default) or "pre" (the app's pre, its own users and data unless it plays with pro's)

name: neblla_export_users
title: Export users
